newsitem.title: JAPAN: General Sekiyu to absorb chemical unit.
newsitem.headline: General Sekiyu to absorb chemical unit.

text.p: General Sekiyu KK said on Thursday that it would absorb its wholly owned petrochemical subsidiary, General Petrochemical Industries Ltd, as part of its efforts to streamline management and cope with stiff domestic competition.
General Sekiyu said in a statement that the move would take effect on September 1.

The petrochemical firm, which is capitalised at 600 million yen, was set up in 1973 to produce and sell benzene, toluene and other building blocks for petrochemical products. It later moved into production and sales of propylene and other products.
General Petrochemical reported sales of 21 billion yen in fiscal 1996/97, ended in March, and current profits of 1.7 billion yen.
